According to Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 [1], 'personal data' means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person (‘data subject’). An identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological or behavioural characteristics of that natural person [1].

According to Article 4(50) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 [2], 'personal data' means personal data as defined in Article 4, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2016/679.

The EU AI Act prohibits the following AI practices outright:

* Placing on the market, putting into service, or using an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person's consciousness or purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques (Article 5) [1]
* Intention to distort behaviour where the distortion results from factors external to the AI system which are outside the control of the provider or the deployer (Article 5) [2]
* Biometric categorisation systems that are based on natural persons' biometric data, such as an individual person's face or fingerprint, to deduce or infer an individuals' political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, race, sex life or sexual orientation (Article 5) [5]
* AI systems intended to be used to detect the emotional state of individuals in situations related to the workplace and education (Article 5) [4]
* Placing on the market strictly for medical or safety reasons, such as systems intended for therapeutical use (Article 5) [4]
* Creating or expanding facial recognition databases through the untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage (Article 5) [6]
* Profiling individuals or assessing their personality traits and characteristics to determine whether they are involved in a criminal offence (Article 5) [6]

Note that these prohibitions do not apply if the AI system is used for medical treatment, psychological treatment of a mental disease, physical rehabilitation, or other lawful purposes.
